# Mates for Mulligans

> Australian golf apparel and accessories with a mental-health message: "check on your mates" and "every mate deserves another shot". 30% of every sale goes to Beyond Blue. Fundraiser: https://workplace-fundraising.raiselysite.com/matesformulligan

## Products

- [The Crossed Clubs Polo](https://www.matesformulligans.com.au/kit/the-crossed-clubs-polo.html): Polos, $79. Check on your mates, printed across the back.
- [Tee It Up Tee](https://www.matesformulligans.com.au/kit/tee-it-up-tee.html): Tees, $54, Black, White, Beige. Every mate deserves another shot. Mulligan mindset.
- [Check On Your Mates Cap](https://www.matesformulligans.com.au/kit/check-on-your-mates-cap.html): Caps, $27, Black, Beige, Grey, White. Crest on the front. The reminder on the back.
- [Sure Grip Glove](https://www.matesformulligans.com.au/kit/sure-grip-glove.html): Accessories, $23. Premium Cabretta leather. Crest on the tab.
- [Golf Towel](https://www.matesformulligans.com.au/kit/golf-towel.html): Accessories, $15. Waffle microfibre with a carabiner clip.
- [Ball Marker Coin](https://www.matesformulligans.com.au/kit/ball-marker-coin.html): Accessories, $12. Enamel coin with a removable 25 mm marker.
- [Gift Voucher](https://www.matesformulligans.com.au/kit/gift-voucher.html): Gifts, from $50. A round on you. Delivered by email.
